brief:
The Israeli military demolished the home of Qadri Samara, a Palestinian prisoner, in the town of Badu northwest of Jerusalem, Maan Wire reported. The demolition is part of ongoing Israeli punitive measures targeting families of detainees and prisoners.

Samara's house was among properties destroyed by Israeli forces in the area as part of collective punishment policies that rights groups have documented throughout the occupation.
title: Israeli army demolishes home of prisoner Qadri Samara in Badu
